mission.name: Overtaking vessel passes too close
mission.description: Own-ship is being overtaken by a faster vessel approaching from near-astern. Rule 13 keeps the overtaking vessel's obligation in force until it is past and clear -- but the overtaker is passing very close. A stand-on/overtaken vessel that does nothing (as Rule 17(a) alone might suggest) risks a close-quarters situation. Correct: Rule 17(b) -- reduce speed rather than turn, once the overtaker's passing distance is clearly too small.
pass_criteria: Own-ship reduces speed (not a large turn) once the overtaker's CPA is too small.

evaluation.verdict: FAIL -- did not reach the goal
